column1: # Ronald (11-04): "Yes, Art's picks": installed with tall grass A and the shrub leaves in their own colours, untinted (fleaves; the greyed cuts kept as leaves_*_grey).
# Don't re-cut leaves_willow/juniper: a few magenta-tinged edge pixels were fixed by hand after cutting.
# Vegetation layers for Plants (vegetation-layers branch) and the mossy fallen sequoia's end. One BLOCK_LIKE per image:

column3: leaf_litter_top|cube|Forest floor leaf litter seen from above: overlapping fallen oak and birch leaves 4-7 px long, brown, russet and dull orange (#5a3a22 #7a4e2a #9a6432 #b8823e) with a few pale yellow birch leaves (#c8a84a), dark soil (#3a2a22) showing in small gaps, lobed oak shapes and small oval birch shapes, every cell filled
column4: leaf_litter_side|face|The side of a forest-floor block: the same dirt as the attached dirt texture (its clods and colours) filling the face, with a lip of fallen brown and orange leaves (#5a3a22 #7a4e2a #9a6432 #b8823e) 3-6 px deep along the top edge, a few leaf tips hanging over unevenly, like the attached grass side's fringe; the left and right edges tile
column5: moss_block_top|cube|A thick carpet of deep green moss seen from above: soft rounded cushions 4-8 px across, deep to fresh green (#24401e #33572a #477236 #5e8c44), each cushion lit on its upper left, tiny pale-green sprouting tips (#7ea456) scattered, darker hollows between cushions, every cell filled
column6: moss_block_side|face|The side of a moss-covered block: the same dirt as the attached dirt texture (its clods and colours) filling the face, with a thick lip of deep green moss (#24401e #33572a #477236 #5e8c44) 4-7 px deep along the top edge, rounded cushions bulging over the edge unevenly, like the attached grass side's fringe; the left and right edges tile

column3: bracken|plant|Bracken fern (for base:fern) standing on the ground: three or four wide spreading fronds on upright stalks, each frond a broad triangle of many small paired leaflets, held out nearly flat and spreading to both sides, fresh green with a yellow-green cast (#3a5e24 #4e7a2e #6a963a #88ae4a), filling most of the width, about 28 px tall
column4: tall_grass_upper_v1@-|tplant|The upper half of a two-block tall prairie grass (big bluestem): long narrow grass blades rising from the bottom edge (they continue the square below, filling it edge to edge at the bottom, 10-14 blades across), thinning upward, with 3-4 slender stalks carrying forked seed heads (three-fingered, like a turkey foot) that end 4-8 px below the top edge, blades bending a little to one side; natural green (#4a6a30 #5e823a #789c48) with the seed heads tinged rust (#8a5a3a)
column5: coarse_dirt|cube|Coarse dirt: the same brown dirt as the attached dirt texture (its colours and clod size), rougher and drier, mixed with many small grey pebbles 2-4 px (#5a5d58 #7e8078 #a0a296) and a few short pale root bits and twigs (#8a7050), every cell filled
column6: tall_grass_lower_v1@-|tplant|The lower half of a two-block tall prairie grass (big bluestem): a dense clump of long narrow grass blades rising from the bottom edge and filling the square up to the top edge (they continue into the square above, 10-14 blades reaching the top edge evenly across its middle 24 px), stems a little darker at the base; natural green (#3e5a2a #4a6a30 #5e823a #789c48)

column3: leaves_willow|fleaves|Shrub willow leaves: many narrow lance-shaped leaves 4-7 px long and 1-2 px wide pointing every way, silvery grey-green (#4a5e48 #64785e #82967a #a4b49a) with pale silver undersides showing on some
column4: leaves_juniper|fleaves|Common juniper foliage: dense short sharp needles and scale-like sprays in blue-green (#2a4440 #36584e #4a6e62 #62887a) with a frosty blue bloom on some tips (#8aa8a4), and two or three small round dusty-blue berries (#5a6e8a)
column5: leaves_creosote|fleaves|Creosote bush: sparse thin dark grey-brown twigs (#4a3e34) zigzagging across, with small paired oval leaves 2-3 px, dark olive-green (#3a4422 #4e5a2c #66723a), sparse, with wide magenta gaps covering 40-50% of the tile
column6: log_sequoia_mossy_top|end|The cut end of a fallen giant sequoia log, matching the attached sequoia log end (the third reference image: the same rings, colours and red-brown bark rim) and the attached mossy bark (the fourth): the same end, with green moss (#3e6a26 #5a8a34 #8eb24c) creeping over the bark rim and in from one corner over a quarter of the face, a few dark cracks radiating from the centre

column1: # Redo of the two-block grass: the first upper half broke into dots at 32 px (blades finer than a game pixel). BLOCK_LIKE=tallgrass

column3: tall_grass_upper_b@-|tplant|The upper half of a two-block tall grass, option B: 7-9 bold grass blades, each 2 px wide (never 1 px), rising from the bottom edge where they continue the square below, tapering to points 6-12 px below the top edge, and two stiff seed stalks 2 px wide ending in small forked rust-brown seed heads (#8a5a3a), solid shapes that read clearly at 32 px; natural green (#4a6a30 #5e823a #789c48)
column4: tall_grass_upper|tplant|The upper half of a two-block tall prairie grass (big bluestem): 8-10 long bold grass blades, each 2 px wide (never 1 px), rising from the bottom edge where they continue the square below, arching a little to one side and tapering to points, and three stiff seed stalks 2 px wide each ending in a forked three-fingered rust seed head (#8a5a3a #a8704a) 4-8 px below the top edge, solid shapes that read clearly at 32 px; natural green (#4a6a30 #5e823a #789c48)
column5: tall_grass_lower_b@-|tplant|The lower half of option B's two-block grass: a dense clump of bold grass blades, each 2 px wide, rising from the bottom edge and filling the square up to the top edge, 8-10 blades reaching the top edge across its middle 24 px so they continue into the square above; natural green (#3e5a2a #4a6a30 #5e823a #789c48)
column6: tall_grass_lower|tplant|The lower half of a two-block tall prairie grass: a dense clump of bold grass blades, each 2 px wide (never 1 px), rising from the bottom edge and filling the square up to the top edge, 9-11 blades reaching the top edge across its middle 24 px so they continue into the square above, the stems a little darker at the base; natural green (#3e5a2a #4a6a30 #5e823a #789c48)
